name: ideation
description: Single-plugin marketplace for the ideation plugin — from pressure-testing whether an idea is worth building, through evidence-gated planning interviews, to contracts, implementation specs, and executed phases.

plugins.name: ideation
plugins.description: Whether, then how, then shipped. /ideation:brainstorm pressure-tests ideas in conversation; the evidence-gated interview, stress-tested by adversarial plan critics, turns a yes into an interactive HTML contract and Markdown specs; /ideation:autopilot runs all phases on a deterministic workflow engine. Watched runs teach the next interview.
